authority: RCA-1.8 directive; provenance audited against git history and committed artifacts

scope.R1: 8x1 is a low-cost SCREENING, never B6 acceptance. It produces no acceptance semantics; 8x3 entry stays behind explicit operator authorization.
scope.R2: Every scheduled attempt is accounted, including abnormal failures (accounting block: scheduled/run_terminal/run_failed/run_integration_failed/snapshot_reproduced/classified/unclassified counts).
scope.R3: No requirement that every run reaches finalization success. Runs with case_outcome_v2=incomplete and/or finalization denial remain valid screening observations (historical precedent: the qualified incumbent's own 24-run series).
scope.R4: Question terminalization (charter q-1 leaving {open, in_progress}) is an INDEPENDENT reported metric and is NOT required to reach 100% for any disposition, including READY_FOR_8X3.
scope.R5: Structural hard gates, grounding regression and negative-case gates remain ZERO-TOLERANCE: any violation blocks READY with NOT_QUALIFIED_SCREENING.
scope.R6: Provider, schema and runtime failures are judged by the frozen applicable thresholds listed under 'gates' — each gate carries its provenance.
scope.R7: Unclassified run-level failures can never enter READY: they force REVIEW_REQUIRED.
scope.R8: No new numeric threshold is introduced by this closure. Qualitative blocking rules (R7 and classified-failure-blocks-READY) come from the RCA-1/RCA-1.8 directives, not from invented tolerance numbers.

gates.provenance: P8A frozen zero-tolerance structural gates (§51); historical, committed
wave-2 §20 grounding separation (commit e3962940 lineage); historical, committed
B5.5 acceptance semantics closure / CaseOutcomeV2 overclaim channel; historical, committed

gates.formula: non-quota schema delegation failures / delegation attempts
gates.provenance: '§15 frozen reliability collapse ceiling (AcceptanceProfile era freeze)', disposition_wave2_screening.py since e3962940 — original denominator is the DELEGATION axis

gates.formula: run-level output-retry failures (failure.json + contained INTEGRATE exhaustion) / scheduled runs
gates.provenance: NO historical normative support for the run-axis denominator: the space-bunny/stepfun screening (3be45146/582bc443) reused the delegation-axis constant on a run-axis fraction. Value retained as the operative screen; provenance must not be presented as historically frozen.
wave-2 §7/§28 quota-degraded-measurement rule (e3962940 lineage); historical, committed

gates.formula: any classified run-level failure (failure.json or contained INTEGRATE failure) blocks READY with its class-specific reason
gates.provenance: RCA-1 directive (RCA-1.5) + RCA-1.8 R8: qualitative rule, zero invented tolerance numbers

gates.formula: any run-level failure with classified=false forces REVIEW_REQUIRED

independent_metrics.definition: charter q-1 left {open, in_progress} (OPEN_STATUSES shared by all disposition scripts)
independent_metrics.note: reported for every series; denominators: scheduled (screening) — failed runs cannot terminalize
covers snapshot-bearing runs only; never presentable as full-measurement verification

cc_resolution.CC-1: RESOLVED: '8/8 pass' at screening level means 'all scheduled runs accounted with zero blocking gate/failure findings' (R2+R5+R6+R7+G8). The stronger acceptance reading is out of scope for 8x1 by R1.
cc_resolution.CC-2: RESOLVED: terminalization is NOT a READY gate (R4/M1). An all-terminal clean series with partial terminalization may reach READY_FOR_8X3 with the metric reported.
